title: The Summit Cairn
subtitle: double-ruled, all the way up
description: The cairn goes up where the road stops pretending, twelve blocks
taken by the press, and the approach is drawn as the survey drew
it: `dash: double`, two hairlines either side of the route, the
line for a road that is walked twice -- once to place the stones,
once to be sure of them.
`double` ignores `weight`, which the survey regards as the line
